lead.title: Google DeepMind unveils Gemini 3.6 Flash, 3.5 Flash-Lite, and 3.5 Flash Cyber
lead.summary: Google DeepMind released three new Gemini models targeting different latency, cost, and security profiles. Gemini 3.6 Flash is the fastest model in the lineup, while 3.5 Flash-Lite offers a cost-efficient tier for budget-constrained workloads. The 3.5 Flash Cyber variant provides enhanced security features for enterprise deployments. The rollout expands Google's frontier AI model portfolio across performance, efficiency, and safety dimensions.

top_stories.title: Nvidia's next-gen Rubin AI chips begin shipping to customers
top_stories.summary: Nvidia announced its Rubin processors are now shipping and entering full production, solidifying its leadership as AMD and Broadcom apply pressure. The company faces scrutiny over whether more efficient models could reduce chip demand.

top_stories.title: Jack Dorsey launches Buzz — team chat, AI agents, and Git hosting in one platform
top_stories.summary: Jack Dorsey's new platform Buzz combines team messaging, built-in AI agents, and Git-based code hosting into a single workspace, aiming to compete with Slack, Notion, and GitHub.

top_stories.title: Humanoid raises $152M Series A at $1.35B valuation for AI-powered robotics
top_stories.summary: The AI robotics startup building humanoid robots closed a $152M Series A led by undisclosed investors, reaching a $1.35B post-money valuation.

top_stories.title: Moonshot AI seeks $50B valuation in pre-IPO funding talks
top_stories.summary: The Chinese LLM developer behind Kimi K3 is in discussions with potential investors for a pre-IPO round that would value the company at approximately $50B.

items.title: ROMS-IMLE proves iterative denoising is not essential for competitive generative modeling
items.summary: A minimalist approach combining IMLE training with a moderate convolutional network achieves FID 2.56 on ImageNet 256 in a single step with strong precision and recall, challenging the necessity of the iterative denoising paradigm.

items.title: Mage-Flow: 4B-parameter native-resolution image generation in 0.59 seconds on a single A100
items.summary: A compact generative stack with a lightweight Mage-VAE tokenizer and native-resolution rectified flow DiT generates 1024² images in 0.59s and edits in 1.02s, with 2.5x training throughput improvement.

items.title: GEAR: Evidence-aware RL rewards improve long-context reasoning by +4.6 points
items.summary: A reward shaping method augments accuracy with grounding reward for key evidence and distractor penalty for irrelevant context, achieving consistent improvements across multiple model scales with larger gains at longer contexts.

items.title: AdaFlash: Adaptive diffusion drafters boost speculative decoding throughput by 66%
items.summary: Addresses variance in diffusion drafters with on-policy distillation and an adaptive length head, achieving up to 66% higher throughput than prior state-of-the-art in high-concurrency scenarios.

items.title: AlayaWorld: a 15B video diffusion transformer for interactive long-horizon world modeling
items.summary: Full technical report of a model generating 24-fps video at 540p/720p autoregressively with persistent sink frame, compressed temporal history, and geometry-aligned spatial memory, reducing inference from ~30 to 4 steps per chunk.

items.title: Nvidia's next-gen Rubin AI chips begin shipping to customers in full production
items.summary: Bloomberg Technology reports Nvidia's Rubin processors are entering mass production and shipping, reinforcing the company's hardware lead amid competitive pressure from AMD and Broadcom.

items.title: Moonshot's Kimi K3 reignites US-China AI race debate on Bloomberg Tech
items.summary: Bessemer Venture Partners partner Sameer Dholakia discussed how Moonshot's Kimi K3 model is reshaping the AI conversation and whether China's open-weight models are closing the gap with OpenAI and Anthropic.

items.title: Poolside releases Laguna S 2.1 — a frontier-class 118B agentic coding model with 1M context
items.summary: Poolside's latest coding model uses an MoE architecture with 8B active parameters, optimized for reasoning and speed. Also launched Laguna XS 2.1 (33B/3B active) for on-device deployment.

items.title: TryAI offers unified access to 30+ frontier models including GPT-5.6, Claude Fable 5, and Gemini 3 Pro
items.summary: A single interface for chat, image, video, and music generation across providers, with pay-as-you-go pricing and no subscriptions.

items.title: Computable launches a GPU marketplace for buying and selling compute by the calendar week
items.summary: Developers can buy, sell, and redeem GPU hours for specific weeks with instant liquidity and wholesale pricing, bypassing rental marketplace markups.

items.title: Humanoid raises $152M Series A at $1.35B valuation for AI-powered humanoid robots
items.summary: The startup building AI-powered humanoid robots closed a massive Series A led by undisclosed investors, reaching unicorn status.

items.title: China's Moonshot AI seeks $50B valuation in pre-IPO funding talks
items.summary: The Kimi K3 developer is in discussions for new capital ahead of a potential IPO, targeting a valuation around $50B.

items.title: SkyPilot from Databricks cofounder raises $20M to be the Switzerland of AI compute
items.summary: An AI compute orchestration platform letting teams shop across clouds, founded by a Databricks cofounder.

items.title: Uniti AI raises $12M Series A for agentic AI platform managing real estate workflows
items.summary: The round was led by Pathlight Ventures with MetaProp, Prudence, Flex Capital, Alate Partners, and RE VC for AI-powered sales, leasing, and operations in real estate.
